verdict.rationale: Reclaim runs many built-in event-triggered automations: it reschedules lower-priority smart events when a meeting overbooks them, adds travel time to events with a location, adds decompression buffers after meetings, syncs Slack status from event categories, and auto-locks Smart Meetings. Users can steer these through settings, priorities and hashtag directives (#reclaim_free, #reclaim_busy, #needs_travel). However, these are preset behaviors, not user-authored rules, so it only partly matches "define rules that trigger actions". Missing for 10: a general user-defined trigger→action rule builder, custom actions or webhooks/API for event-driven automation, and independent hands-on corroboration of rule-style automation.
